title: Reception of an ESM STATUS message by an ESM entity

entities.name: ESM STATUS message
entities.description: Message sent to report certain error conditions detected upon receipt of ESM protocol data. Can be sent by both MME and UE.

entities.name: ESM cause #43 (Invalid EPS bearer identity)
entities.description: Error condition indicating an invalid EPS bearer identity was received.

entities.name: ESM cause #81 (Invalid PTI value)
entities.description: Error condition indicating an invalid Procedure Transaction Identity (PTI) value was received.

entities.name: ESM cause #97 (Message type non-existent or not implemented)
entities.description: Error condition indicating a message type that is non-existent or not implemented was received.

entities.name: Abort ongoing ESM procedure
entities.description: Procedure to abort any ongoing ESM procedure related to the received EPS bearer identity or PTI value.

entities.name: Stop related timer
entities.description: Action to stop any timer related to the aborted ESM procedure.

entities.name: Deactivate EPS bearer context locally
entities.description: Procedure to deactivate the corresponding EPS bearer context locally without peer-to-peer signaling.

entities.name: EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Identifier for an EPS bearer context.

entities.name: Procedure Transaction Identity (PTI)
entities.description: Identifier for an ESM procedure transaction.

relations.description: ESM STATUS message behavior is determined by ESM cause value #43.
ESM STATUS message behavior is determined by ESM cause value #81.
ESM STATUS message behavior is determined by ESM cause value #97.
ESM cause #43 triggers abortion of ongoing ESM procedure related to EPS bearer identity.
ESM cause #43 triggers stopping of related timer.
ESM cause #43 triggers local deactivation of EPS bearer context.
ESM cause #81 triggers abortion of ongoing ESM procedure related to PTI value.
ESM cause #81 triggers stopping of related timer.
ESM cause #97 triggers abortion of ongoing ESM procedure related to PTI or EPS bearer identity.
ESM cause #97 triggers stopping of related timer.
Abort procedure may be related to EPS bearer identity.
Abort procedure may be related to PTI value.
